scope: refresh during pre-chapter gate and textbook lookup
browser back and interrupted gate re-entry

fixes.problem: After a repeated wrong, textbook lookup obligation existed only in the current rendered screen. Refresh/back could reopen the question before textbook lookup.
fixes.fix: lastBookPromptAt is persisted in the permanent wrong registry; needsBookLookup() reconstructs the mandatory textbook-lookup state. Both Day1-6 and Day7-18 book-gate engines render the lookup screen first after reload/re-entry.

fixes.problem: Day1-6 source wrong notes use lastAt and problemStatus uses at, but the permanent registry previously preferred lastWrongAt/updatedAt. Re-syncing an old wrong could therefore manufacture a new current timestamp and invalidate PASS or reopen a resolved record.
fixes.fix: Day1-6 registry import now reads lastWrongAt -> lastAt -> updatedAt -> createdAt, and mastery uses wrongNote.masteredAt / problemStatus.at / problemStatus.updatedAt. Existing registry lastWrongAt is retained as fallback instead of Date.now().

fixes.problem: Generic Firebase object reconciliation can combine a status string from one device with newer timestamp fields from another, producing an internally inconsistent wrong record.
fixes.fix: wrong_answer_registry.js normalizes every loaded/saved record using resolvedAt, lastResolvedAt, lastBookPromptAt and lastWrongAt. Pending textbook lookup, resolved state and recurring/open state are reconstructed from time-order invariants.

verified_paths.direct_day_url: pre_chapter_gate_guard.js runs on Day2-6 student_flow_app and Day7-18 fast_day after registry sync; required prior wrong review cannot be skipped by opening the normal Day URL directly.
verified_paths.hub_links: fast_index.html links Day1-6 only to student_flow_app pages and Day7-18 only to fast_day.html routes; no normal learner link exposes the metacog implementation page.
verified_paths.back_navigation: Returning from a book-gate page to pre_chapter_wrong_gate leaves the same item unfinished; relaunching it reads pending textbook lookup and returns to textbook lookup before question retry.
verified_paths.gate_pass: PASS is bound to the deterministic source-wrong revision and is invalidated only when actual source wrong history changes.
verified_paths.firebase: history2-wrong-answer-registry-v1 is covered by the generic history2-* cloud sync prefix; registry-side normalization repairs merge inconsistencies.
verified_paths.release_config: app_mode_config.js is buildMode=release with persistProgress=true, persistLearningHistory=true, firebaseSync=true, freeNavigation=false and adminStartsInDevConsole=false.
verified_paths.mobile_gate: pre_chapter_wrong_gate and both textbook lookup UIs collapse to a single-column primary-action layout at small widths.

non_blocking_known_item.item: esc() uses &quot without a semicolon for the double-quote entity.
non_blocking_known_item.risk: low; browser entity parsing normally tolerates it, but fix at the next safe full-file edit or release freeze if practical.

deployment.pages_observation: Several rapid commits received GitHub Pages duration=0 immediate Page build failed responses. This pattern previously alternated with successful builds. Final release build success must be confirmed on the single frozen Stage 3 commit before declaring Exam Release 1.0.

limitation: No interactive browser carrying the learner's actual localStorage/Firebase account state is available in this environment. This stage verifies static/runtime state transitions and persistence logic, not a visual click-through claim.
